name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, March 06, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Captain Beringer and Department Staff - LA County Sheriff's Department Update
b.
California Water Service on the Palos Verdes Peninsula Water Reliability Project
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-e, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special and Regular Meetings of February 20, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Request for Consent to Assign Current Legal Services Agreement from Jenkins and Hogin, LLP to Best, Best and Krieger, LLP.
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 3 to Legal Services Agreement between City of Lomita and Jenkins & Hogin LLP to consent to an assignment to Best, Best, & Krieger LLP of the agreement.
Item #7d
e.
Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with CivilSource, Inc. for design of the Walnut Street Rehabilitation and Water Main Replacement Project
ACTION: It is recommended that that the City Council:
1)
Award a Professional Services Agreement to CivilSource, Inc. in the amount of $29,556 to perform design services to replace the Walnut Street Rehabilitation and Water Main Replacement Project; and
2)
Approve a total contract budget of $32,511.60 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions); and
3)
Authorize the City Manager to sign the agreement.
Item #7e
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A BICYCLE AND PEDESTRIAN MASTER PLAN AS A GUIDANCE DOCUMENT FOR THE CITY
Presented by the City's Consultant - Nelson/Nygaard Consulting Associates
RES 2018-07 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California adopting a Bicycle and Pedestrian Master Plan as a guidance document for prioritizing and implementing future projects within the City.
Item #8
9.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF THE 2017 PAVEMENT MANAGEMENT PROGRAM
Presented by Peter Bucknam, Bucknam Infrastructure Group
ACTION: Receive and file the final report for the 2017 Pavement Management Program.
Item #9
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
10.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF AN ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT ON THE GENERAL PLAN AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE HOUSING ELEMENT
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ACTION: That after holding the public hearing; the City Council approve by minute order to accept the 2017 Report on the progress of the General Plan and on the implementation of the Housing Element, and direct staff to submit the Report to the State Office of Planning and Research (OPR) and the State Housing and Community Development (HCD) Departments.
Item #10
11.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE RELATED TO ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS WITHIN THE RESIDENTIAL ZONES OF THE CITY
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ORD NO. 796 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING 11-1.15.01(A), 11-1.15.10(J), 11-1.15.12(L), 11-1.15.19(S), 11-1.30.01, 11-1.30.02, 11-1.30.05, and 11-1.30.06 to conform to recently enacted legislation pertaining to accessory dwelling units. (First Reading)
ACTION: That after conducting the public hearing and after the City Attorney reads the title, that the Council introduce first reading of an ordinance amending sections 11-1.15.01(A), 11-1.15.10(J), 11-1.15.12(L), 11-1.15.19(S), 11-1.30.01, 11-1-30.02, 11-1.30.05, and 11-1.30.06 of the Lomita Municipal Code to conform to recently enacted State legislation pertaining to accessory dwelling units and conform the categorical exemption; and that said ordinance be scheduled for a second reading on March 20, 2018.
Item #11
12.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Gary Osborne to a Special Joint Meeting with the Railroad Museum Board to be held on Tuesday, March 20, 2018, at 5:00 p.m., City Hall Upstairs Assembly Room, followed by the Regular Meeting to be held at 6:30 p.m., in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
